title: Algebraic fibre criterion for a principal ideal (Tag 062Y)
statement: Let A, B and K be commutative rings with A-algebra structures on B and K. Assume B is flat and finitely presented over A and K is a field. Let I=(f) be a principal ideal of B, and let q be a prime ideal of B whose contraction to A is the kernel of A\to K. Assume that every prime ideal P of B\otimes_A K has an element g_P\notin P such that the extension of I to the localization (B\otimes_A K)_{g_P} is generated by a nonzerodivisor. Then there exists g\in B with g\notin q such that IB_g is generated by a nonzerodivisor of B_g and B_g/IB_g is flat over A.
